example.title: Lee House (Grover Street Victorian Historic District)

brief: Two-storey Queen Anne house near the university, re-sided in pale grey vinyl with white trim: a steep hipped roof with lower cross gables, one a front gable with fish-scale shingles and paired windows, and curved scroll brackets at the cut-away corners of the upper floor. A small gabled entry porch on turned posts with a spindle rail and a '212' in the pediment. An open octagonal gazebo with a dark domed roof sits in the side yard; ball-topped planters by the steps.
